title: deployment regression watchdog for eval-driven rollouts
creator: Anya Patel
description: Build a "Regression Watchdog" service that continuously evaluates live canary/AB/shadow traffic outputs against configurable golden prompt sets and per-prompt scorecards. The watchdog must produce a composite quality score and gated signals that integrate with the rollout controller to automatically attenuate or rollback variants when statistically-significant regressions are detected. Goals: detect subtle quality drops (not just latency/errors), provide transparent per-prompt diagnostics in Console, and keep false-positive rollbacks below an acceptable threshold via traffic-aware statistics and human-in-loop approvals.
acceptance_criteria: Watchdog consumes mirrored/shadowed responses for canary and shadow routes with <10s processing latency for a 95th percentile of eval checks.
Composite quality score computed per model-variant and compared to baseline using configurable thresholds (absolute delta and z-score / bootstrap CI).
Automatic policy paths: scale-down, pause rollout, and auto-rollback (with optional 10-min human confirmation window).
Console tile shows per-prompt contribution breakdown, trend chart, and links to failing golden prompts and diffs.
Alerting to Ops/Oncall via PagerDuty and Slack with contextual metadata and a reproducible evaluation link.
Tests: unit tests for scoring functions, integration test with rollout controller, and load test validating <5% CPU overhead for typical canary traffic volumes.
tasks: Design scorecard schema (per-prompt weights, comparison metrics: BLEU/ROUGE/embedding-sim/lextok diff). -> Confluence: /confluence/display/RW/Watchdog+Scorecard+Spec
Implement mirror consumer in ingress proxy to stream minimal payloads to eval queue (redact PII per policy).
Build eval worker pool (python + JIT ops) with pluggable metric modules and caching layer for embeddings.
Expose Watchdog API to Rollout Controller: /v1/watchdog/evaluate and /v1/watchdog/decision
Create Console UX: per-rollout Watchdog panel and per-prompt drilldown (frontend story in DES backlog).
Integrate PagerDuty/Slack runbook and auto-rollback workflow with audit log entries.
notes: Trade-offs: running full golden-set evals on every request is cost-prohibitive. We'll sample mirrored traffic and run light-weight heuristics first, promoting to heavier checks for borderline cases.
Decision: use weighted composite score rather than single metric to reduce sensitivity to metric-specific noise (embedding sim + token-level diffs + heuristic answer checks).
Privacy: mirror pipeline must redact user-identifying tokens before storing or sending to eval workers; see security policy doc: /confluence/display/RW/Privacy+Eval+Guidelines.
Statistical approach: default gating uses bootstrap confidence intervals on the delta of composite scores vs baseline; fallback to A/B test with pooled variance if sample sizes allow.
Cost mitigations: cache golden prompt embeddings and reuse across eval workers; use bloom-filtered prefix cache to skip exact repeats.
